Questions

How do I edit this page?

Open index.html in any text editor and change the text. All styles are in one block at the top.

Can I change the colors?

Yes. Edit the five variables at the top of the style block (--a, --b, --bg, --card, --ink).

Where can I host it?

Any static host: GitHub Pages, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, or your own server.
